confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded by aggregated 2026 cost-of-living figures for the Philippines and El Nido-specific aggregator pages, which vary widely by source and venue; cocktail and wine values lean on the beer relationship because direct El Nido menu evidence was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied city context, not from inspected booking pages or current listings. The FX observation is from a search summary of RBA daily rates and could not be confirmed against the F11.1 table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Philippine island tourism towns (Boracay, Coron, Puerto Galera) with El Nido priced somewhat above the national average for restaurant and bar items, and accommodation benchmarked to similar Palawan beach-town guesthouses and hostels.
